sealed_results: unchanged; M46 fresh_new was not rewritten
mechanism: X-only schedule-closed detour cross after a mature full-pool CAS. One terminal sortie absorbs the single ground parcel of its recovery-only stop, recovers at another truck's existing visit, and the stop is deleted. Emission requires the original J proxy (geometric detour, paid-timeline hover, same Q and Qij) to improve. Physical, J, fixed-scenario, H, robust and CAS gates are the original ones.
why_not_the_exchange: Swapping two terminal recoveries on C100 and R100 was physically feasible, kept the air set, and created two real crosses, but original J worsened by 13 to 46 yuan. Those plans are not emitted.
sealed_champion_screen: All six M46 X champions: zero emitted, zero native calls. Best proxy J gain was negative on every map that had a candidate stop (C100 -4.306, R50 -32.250, R100 -18.859, RC100 -17.994). C50 and RC50 have no recovery-only single-parcel stop.
fresh_x_nominal: Six fresh X nominals, budget 1000 physical / phase-2 200, adopt_from the sealed K1 S plans. S was not re-solved. Every published cost, air count, cross count, physical envelope and FUNNEL_CROSS matched the sealed M46 X result. The operator emitted 0 paid candidates on every map. Best in-search proxy J gains: C50 -51.782, R50 -32.250, C100 -4.306, R100 -18.859, RC100 -17.994; RC50 had no eligible stop. Wall seconds: C50 9.8, R50 10.6, RC50 9.1, C100 35.7, R100 38.1, RC100 37.5. Actual worlds were not run.
